notes: Babylonian (Nisan) reckoning: year 1 began 6 Apr 485; year 3 began 14 Apr 483; year 7 began 31 Mar 479 (Tebeth, month X, from 22 Dec 479); year 12 began 5 Apr 474 (Parker & Dubberstein, p. 30).
title: King of Persia (Babylonian dating)

start_window.basis: Last firm tablet of Darius I 30 Sep 486 (a damaged one of 7? Nov 486); first tablet of Xerxes's accession year 1 Dec 486 (Parker & Dubberstein 1942, pp. 14–15): Darius died in November 486.

end_window.basis: An unpublished Persepolis text of Xerxes's year 20, months X–XII (XII ended 24 Mar 465); Cowley 6 is dated "year 21, the accession year of Artaxerxes" (3 Jan 464) (Parker & Dubberstein 1942, p. 15).
